name: three_bar_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Three consecutive same-direction bars with expanding volume and range indicate a micro-momentum burst that persists for 5-15 more bars. This pattern captures institutional order flow that executes over multiple minutes. The first bar initiates, the second confirms, the third signals that the flow hasn't been fully absorbed yet. Edge persists because the pattern is too fast for most retail traders to act on and too small for most institutional systems to bother with.
stock_filter: top 30 FnO by avg daily turnover

exit.signal_exit: first bar that closes opposite to trade direction

filters.time_filter: no trades first 10 min or last 15 min
filters.spread_filter: skip if spread > 0.06% (tight spreads needed for small edge)
other_filters: minimum 3rd bar range > 0.05% (not a doji pattern)

edge.edge_decay_risk: high — simple pattern, easily crowded by other systems

weaknesses: Very tight target (20 bps) and stop (15 bps) means costs are a huge % of gross edge — slippage kills
High trade frequency (up to 12/day) amplifies brokerage costs — ₹40 * 12 = ₹480/day fixed cost
Three green/red bars with expanding volume is common during the open — many false signals in noisy periods
prior_art: Three soldiers / three crows candlestick pattern with quantitative volume/range filters
notes: Consider a 5-min timeframe version for cleaner signals and lower cost impact.
